name: Morgan Espitia
title: Software Engineer
summary: Software engineer since 2017: six years employed full-stack — front-end, then back-end, then both; PHP, Node, React and TypeScript — for credit unions, a healthcare-benefits platform and enterprise dashboards, then a studio that ships in the open. Owns a UI end to end and the service behind it. Everything since 2023 has receipts: seventeen public products with their source, benchmarks and weak spots published.

bullets: Client and contract work under NDA: blockchain infrastructure and full-stack product work.

Built and operate TokenSafe, a production Node/TypeScript API that scores Solana tokens from on-chain data and charges per request over x402 micropayments, and Scry, its React web UI and Telegram bot. Deployed with Docker; Prometheus metrics and structured logs.
Built Perennials, an offline-first React/TypeScript app over a Node/PostgreSQL service that searches ~8,800 plants by the conditions you have; every search is a URL.

Ship and maintain the public work at ampactor.dev: a self-hosting compiler, a cross-platform DSP kernel flashed to real hardware, a SIMD sort on crates.io that publishes its losses, a Solana execution crate whose CI lands live transactions, and a dozen browser instruments and games.
Build and maintain production applications and integrations, including deployment, debugging and ongoing support.
Built WordPress sites, custom business tooling, migration systems and automated recurring processes.
Built and maintained the PHP dashboard enterprise IT teams use to manage and stream product-shipping data.
Maintained its asynchronous Node.js backend (WebSockets, RabbitMQ); overhauled CI/CD and onboarding, cutting build failures by about 30%.
Engineered the PHP backend of a healthcare-benefits platform handling sensitive medical and financial data.
Built fault-tolerant synchronization pipelines with Salesforce and maintained high-throughput backend workflows.
Built and maintained the PHP ticket-management system used across the customer-service organization: messaging, escalation and workflow features.
Built and shipped PHP websites for credit unions and other clients, including OASCU and National Geographic's credit union.
